elements.label: EXAMPLE 3.6
elements.title: Calculate the range for Dataset A and Dataset B
elements.details:
| Dataset | Exam Scores |
|---------|-------------|
| A       | 40, 70, 100 |
| B       | 69, 70, 71  |

Range calculations:
- Dataset A: Max = 100, Min = 40, Range = 100 - 40 = 60
- Dataset B: Max = 71, Min = 69, Range = 71 - 69 = 2
elements.summary: This example shows the calculation of the range for two datasets, illustrating that Dataset A has a much larger range (60) compared to Dataset B (2), indicating greater variability in Dataset A.
